capabilities.description: Import and categorize financial transactions from multiple sources, including manual entry and bank feeds.
Visualize income, expenses, cash flow, and net worth through interactive dashboards with charts and summaries.
Set budgets for categories, monitor spending against limits, and receive notifications when thresholds are approached or exceeded.
Generate detailed financial reports such as profit and loss, expense breakdowns, and tax summaries in various formats.
Maintain an immutable audit trail of all financial transactions and changes for compliance and dispute resolution.
Securely synchronize financial data across devices and external institutions using event-driven architecture.

summary: LedgerFlow is a personal finance management platform that helps individuals and small teams track income and expenses, automate budgeting, and gain actionable insights into their financial health. It connects to bank accounts, categorizes transactions, and provides dashboards, alerts, and recommendations to improve savings and spending habits.
